title: Surname_Index
description: Lightweight lookup index mapping normalized lowercase surnames and spelling variants to canonical person references.

schema_version.description: Version identifier for the surname index schema.

last_modified.description: [REQUIRED] ISO-8601 date of last index compilation.

total_surnames.description: [REQUIRED] Total count of canonical surnames indexed.

aliases.description: Lookup dictionary mapping normalized lowercase spelling variants directly to canonical surname keys.

surnames.description: [REQUIRED] Dictionary keyed by normalized lowercase surname mapping to matching person entries.

spelling_variants.description: Observed or historical spelling variations associated with this surname.

total_persons.description: [REQUIRED] Total count of persons matching this surname.

persons.description: [REQUIRED] List of lightweight person references associated with this surname.
